---
name: Evidence integrity
description: Requirements, acceptance criteria and sign-off records
applyTo: "evidence/**, docs/*test*, docs/*gate*, docs/*risk*"
---

Every entry needs date, board revision, instrument, supply/cell part number, input conditions, measured min/max, status PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN, and owner. Mark unavailable observations NOT_RUN. Log actual oscilloscope screenshots under evidence if provided; do not synthesize measurements. A numerical pass requires stated tolerances and rationale.
